lines.text: A new heaven and a new earth appear, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
An angel shows the holy city from a high mountain, and its twelve gates bear the names of Israel's tribes.
The angel measures the city with a golden rod, and each of the twelve gates is a single emerald.
No temple is in the city, and its gates never shut at day's end, since there is no night.
A river of life flows from God's throne, and the tree of life bears ten kinds of fruit.
